purpose: Separate durable Sector-A theorem families from branch packages, development anchors, and subproof gates without renumbering issued claim IDs.

new_claim_criteria: The statement is mathematically independent of the current parent objective.
The scope and falsifier remain meaningful when cited without the parent proof diary.
The result has its own reproducible verification package or an explicitly staged package plan.
The result is intended to be a durable external citation target.
The unit is not merely a lemma, route comparison, obstruction, counterexample, or next gate inside an active claim.

active_frontier.success_condition: Continue after R-083 at A13-CLASSII-FUTURE-CONTROL-WEIGHTED-INNOVATION-BRACKET. R-079 closes the exact complete frame-current and canonical safe-packet Doob decomposition and proves the weighted Cameron--Martin square function plus predictable base-current heat projection. R-080 closes both distinct low objects for the declared regular no-revisit class and reduces far feedback to one localized base-current tail. R-081 splits that current into a far-vanishing polynomial channel and one nonlinear Cartan channel, proves deterministic relative-gap decay, and exposes both the half-derivative root-sum boundary and the upper-triangular nonlinear NEAR defect invisible to D_jA. R-082 rewrites the complete FAR wedge as one deterministic stopped-current square retaining its moving endpoint and both predictable drifts, corrects raw-value centering by pairing it with the heat compensator, and closes the uncontrolled production FAR subbranch with cutoff-uniform 2^(-2 beta C) decay for every strict beta<3 alpha-1. R-083 closes all three controlled polynomial stopped-FAR rows exactly for C>=3, including both endpoints and predictable drifts, and reduces the remaining controlled CFAR object to three Cartan input-scale telescope squares with coefficient 3/(80P). The K-shell coordinate estimate spends each input once, but an exact production-floor-rescaled harmonic witness rules out automatic output orthogonality, so correlated or signed Cartan CFAR remains open. R-083 also derives the exact linear Pauli--Fierz Gram, heat lift, quadratic secant, conditional-covariance defect, and nine-block forest. An adapted zero-rational-row fixture has negative linear-row zero chaos, so complete signed NEAR must recombine the linear and rational rows with paid subtraction and the full forest. R-081 temporal Douglas factorisation preserves complete-packet algebra for overlapping bounded-simple packets, but one-shot graph non-density requires an overlap-stable bounded-simple complete-packet lower bound and then the A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION. Only after controlled Cartan CFAR, complete signed NEAR, and PROG may controlled-shell one-use and the conditional q=10/9 Nelson synthesis be invoked. Sector A remains open.
